replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body: In terms of gameplay, I suppose it does hold that rather intriguing essence to it, or at least bits of the surface area does. I really can't tell much because the inside areas of the map are really crammed up that it's impossible to discern whether they're to be comfortably navigated by players or not, and along that the inability to tunnel down for extra space really limits mobility. The bridge connecting both sides could also signify some trouble and could either prompt the map to be easily rushed or for it to stalemate endlessly. In terms of looks... it's acceptable enough, I suppose. Applying more variety to the map could help, and reducing the excessive amount of glowstone could, as well...

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
What  a layout! {tag=a3f32cc28f9847feaf1107aa945a8bd0}

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✘] Detail
[✓] Room for building & Fighting
[✘] Layers & Structures
[✘] XML
[✘] Etiquette Kit
[✓] Accessibility 
[✓] Sufficient Recourses 
[✓] Lag Free

Tips:

The map itself is plain and the glowstone is just random. I suggest you add Team coloured borders around the map and on the road then put the glowstone in the middle. 

I suggest adding some structures like some sandstone barracks to prevent users getting shot or stuff like that.

To be honest this map should be a TDM. The style & layout seems very common to be used in TDM maps. You should just replace the objectives with score boxes and see how it goes as for it'd fit better as a TDM.

Need a reference to XML? Click Here

Conclusion:

The map looks plain yet I like that aspect of it and it seems like an extremely well-thoughtout layout. However I think it suits TDM best and I believe that it would have a higher chance to be accepted with my edits and changing to a TDM map.


Thanks & love the style,

Tiger
